title: The supported open-unit cone remains supported and quasi-coherent
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with chosen derived module categories for X and its over-sites [def-pc-derived-category]. Let T be closed, U quasi-compact open, L exact derived restriction to U, and adj:L left adjoint to any R. Let K be quasi-coherent with all cohomology stalks off T zero. In every distinguished triangle K --adj.unit_K to R(L(K)) --g to C --h to K[1], C is quasi-coherent, its cohomology stalks off T are zero, and L(C) is zero. This statement has no orthogonality, affine-cover, or perfectness assumption.

source.place: Tag 09IR, first unit-cone paragraph; Tag 08D5; cohomology.tex Tag 08DF support/base-change argument

proof.text: Apply supported_open_unit_image_properties to obtain quasi-coherence and support for the second vertex R(L(K)). The first vertex K has the same property by hypothesis. Apply supported_qcoh_isTriangulated and ObjectProperty.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed3 to the supplied distinguished triangle. Transport quasi-coherence and subsingleton stalks along the resulting cone isomorphism.

Apply derived_open_unit_restriction_isIso to K. Exact derived restriction maps the supplied triangle to a distinguished triangle with invertible first arrow. Mathlib Triangle.isZero3_of_isIso1 makes its third vertex L(C) zero. Assemble the three conclusions.

theorem supported_open_unit_cone_properties
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ W : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (R : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ⥤
      schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (adj : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ R)
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (hKT : (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K.obj).val.presheaf x))))
    (C : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (g : R.obj ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj) ⟶ C)
    (h : C ⟶ K.obj⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (htri : Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk (adj.unit.app K.obj) g h ∈ distTriang _) :
    schemeDerivedQCohProperty X C ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj C).val.presheaf x))) ∧
      IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj C)
